tools.name: x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search
tools.description: A special tool that returns a trimmed down list of tools given a context. Use this tool only when there are many tools available and you want to get a subset that matches the provided context.

vast_type.description: Legacy/advanced exchange type filter. Leave unset unless your client already depends on it.

vasp_score_gt.description: Optional lower bound for VASP score.

limit.description: Maximum number of exchanges to return.

vasp_score_lt.description: Optional upper bound for VASP score.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetExchanges
tools.description: Returns prediction market venues or entity metadata. Use when an agent needs exchange identifiers or wants to inspect available entities. For normal market discovery, /prediction-markets is usually more useful.

publishDateFrom.description: Inclusive UTC start time for news publication date.

publishDateTo.description: Inclusive UTC end time for news publication date.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetMarketNews
tools.description: Returns recent news items in a publish date range. Quality and relevance thresholds are applied automatically and the industry segment is fixed to prediction-markets, so only the publish window needs to be supplied. Use this endpoint for recent context, not for exact pricing or event metadata.

annotations.title: Get recent news relevant to prediction markets

from.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

interval.description: Bucket size in milliseconds. Common values: 300000 (5 minutes) or 3600000 (1 hour).

to.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetMarketOverview
tools.description: Returns time-bucketed prediction market activity across exchanges. Returns one row per time bucket per exchange, with fields such as entityCode, entityName, sourceId, volumeUsd, tradeCount and volume. Use this endpoint when the agent needs exchange-level activity trends rather than individual market details.

annotations.title: Get market-wide volume and trade-count overview by exchange

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetMarketRecap
tools.description: Returns a short natural-language recap of recent market activity plus summary metrics. Returns an array of narrative paragraphs, a generatedAt timestamp, source, and summary fields such as predictionVolume24h and newsCount. Use this endpoint when an agent needs a concise explanation rather than raw market data.

from.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

interval.description: Bucket size in milliseconds. Common values: 300000 (5 minutes) or 3600000 (1 hour).

to.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetOpenInterest
tools.description: Returns time-bucketed open interest across exchanges. Returns rows keyed by time, sourceId, entityCode and entityName, with openInterestUsd as the primary metric. Use this endpoint for market size/exposure monitoring rather than trade activity.

annotations.title: Get time-series of open interest by exchange

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetPMCSstats
tools.description: Returns nested PMCS statistics and counts for currently indexed markets. Use this endpoint for faceted navigation, dashboards, and to understand which PMCS branches contain the most markets. This is a count/rollup endpoint, not a market-detail endpoint. If you need actual markets, call /prediction-markets.

annotations.title: Get live PMCS counts by hierarchy and exchange

from.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

interval.description: Bucket size in milliseconds. Common values: 300000 (5 minutes) or 3600000 (1 hour).

to.description: UTC start/end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetPredictionMarketTotalVolume
tools.description: Returns time-bucketed total prediction market volume summary. Use this when an agent only needs volume trendlines and not the richer exchange-level market overview. If the agent also needs trade counts or explicit entity breakdowns, prefer /market-overview.

annotations.title: Get time-series of total prediction market volume

open_interest_max.description: Maximum open interest filter. Response fields are USD-normalized.

queryCriteria.description: Legacy/advanced query field. Prefer search unless your client already depends on this parameter.

sort_by.description: Sort key. Common values: total_volume_usd_1hr, total_open_interest_usd, end_ts, total_volume_24hr.

event_ticker.description: Exact event identifier. Use this when you already know the target market and want a direct filter.

pmcs_supersector.description: PMCS supersector code from /prediction-markets/taxonomy, for example POL, SOC, WX, CRY, or AIT.

search.description: Free-text query across market/event names. Best first-pass search field for human topics such as Trump or oil.

searchString.description: Legacy search alias. Prefer search for new agent implementations.

open_interest_min.description: Minimum open interest filter. Response fields are USD-normalized.

entity_code.description: Exchange/entity filter. Common values: KALSHI, POLYMARK, and GMNI.

volume_min.description: Minimum total volume filter. Use only when you intentionally want to filter low-liquidity markets.

outcome_type.description: Outcome model filter. Common values: Binary or Multi.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Typical values are 10, 44, or 100.

pmcs_category.description: Top-level PMCS category code from /prediction-markets/taxonomy, for example SCI, GEO, MKT, SPT, SOC, or OTH.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction. Use desc for most-active markets and asc for nearest-expiring or lowest-to-highest lists.

status.description: Market status filter. Open is the safest default for active trading workflows.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetPredictionMarkets
tools.description: Primary market discovery endpoint. Returns paginated event-level market objects with nested outcome snapshots. Use this endpoint first whenever an agent needs to find markets by keyword, exchange, PMCS code, status, outcome type, volume, open interest, or time-to-expiry. Reuse event_ticker from the response as the stable identifier for /prediction-markets/similar and for single-market history endpoints. This endpoint is the safest starting point for weaker agents.

annotations.title: Search, filter, and sort prediction markets

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetPredictionMarketsTaxonomy
tools.description: Returns the valid PMCS taxonomy dictionary used by the market search endpoints. The response includes multiple hierarchy levels such as category, supersector, macrosector, midsector, and subsector. Use this endpoint before sending filters like pmcs_category or pmcs_supersector so the agent only uses known codes. Codes are short identifiers such as SCI, GEO, MKT, SPT, POL, SOC, or WX.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets/points to return. For example, 288 returns 24 hours of 5-minute candles.

from.description: UTC start timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

interval.description: Bucket size in milliseconds. Example: 300000 for 5-minute data.

to.description: UTC end timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

event.description: Exact event ticker or market identifier, usually obtained from /prediction-markets.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetPriceHistory
tools.description: Returns historical pricing for one market on one exchange.

annotations.title: Get price history for a single market

limit.description: Maximum number of similar events to return.

event_ticker.description: Exact source market identifier returned by /prediction-markets.

tools.name: prediction-markets___GetSimilarMarkets
tools.description: Given a source event_ticker, returns semantically similar markets. Useful for cross-exchange matching, recommendations, and finding equivalent or near-equivalent contracts on other venues. Agents should always obtain event_ticker from /prediction-markets first instead of guessing it.

annotations.title: Find similar markets from the same or other entities
